mechanism: Both agents increase infection risk through immunosuppression (infliximab via TNF-alpha inhibition) and potential osteonecrosis of the jaw risk is elevated with combined use in patients receiving bisphosphonates during immunosuppressive therapy.
action: Monitor closely for signs of infection and osteonecrosis of the jaw; ensure adequate dental care and consider dental evaluation before initiating zoledronic acid; maintain vigilant surveillance during concurrent use.
